about.meta_description: Meet Gabi Miranda, a software engineer specializing in mobile (Kotlin, React Native) and frontend, with a focus on quality, accessibility and high-scale products.

hero.bio: I started in frontend, moved to mobile, and ended up doing both at the same time. I've worked on a delivery platform, a design system used by multiple teams, and two years in banking at Stone — with React Native, Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform in a codebase with over 500 modules.
hero.bio2: My thesis was about digital accessibility and that care never left. I like documentation that actually helps, tests that trust fakes over mocks and components that work for everyone. I'm currently exploring how AI can fit into the development workflow without becoming a shortcut to bad code. On the side, building personal projects in native Kotlin to sharpen my Android skills.

items.description: Main stack in Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform on a product with over 500K daily active users, in a codebase with 500+ modules — Clean Architecture + MVVM, Kodein, Ktorfit, Coroutines and Flow. React Native as a pluggable integration layer for the mobile app. Monitoring with Datadog, A/B testing with Amplitude and Firebase.
Design system and rebranding for multiple internal teams. Components with Stencil.js, WCAG accessibility and Storybook documentation.
Delivery and marketplace platform. Stack in React.js, Next.js and React Native. Contributions to product, performance and partner integrations.
